% algorithm2e (with ifoddpage and relsize) and the algorithms bundle's
% algorithmic (from TeX Live in the images, #69). algorithm2e cannot be
% combined with algorithm / algpseudocode (siunitx.tex), hence a document of
% its own.
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage[ruled,linesnumbered]{algorithm2e}
\usepackage{algorithmic}
\begin{document}
\begin{algorithm}[h]
  \caption{Sum}
  \KwIn{$n$}
  \KwOut{$s$}
  $s \leftarrow 0$\;
  \For{$i \leftarrow 1$ \KwTo $n$}{
    $s \leftarrow s + i$\;
  }
\end{algorithm}
\begin{algorithmic}
  \STATE $s \gets 0$
  \FOR{$i = 1$ to $n$}
    \STATE $s \gets s + i$
  \ENDFOR
\end{algorithmic}
\end{document}
